name: South Carolina
agencyName: South Carolina Department of Motor Vehicles

retake.waitBetweenAttempts: Next day (may retest after one day)

gdl.fullLicenseMinAge: 17, or after 12 violation- and at-fault-collision-free months on a conditional/special restricted license
gdl.permitHoldingPeriod: 6 months (minors); 18+ must hold the permit at least 30 days before the road test
gdl.nightCurfew: Conditional/special restricted: solo driving 6 a.m.-6 p.m. (until 8 p.m. during daylight saving time); licensed driver 21+ required until midnight and a qualified individual required midnight-6 a.m.
gdl.passengerLimits: No more than 2 passengers under 21 unless traveling to/from school or with a licensed adult 21+

requiredDocuments: Proof of identity (e.g. certified birth certificate or U.S. passport)
Two proofs of South Carolina residential address
process.realIdNotes: REAL ID cards require proof of identity, one proof of SSN, and two proofs of current residential address. Standard (non-REAL ID) licenses remain available.
process.visionStandard: 20/40 in at least one eye (with or without corrective lenses) for an unrestricted license

facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: 12 or more points results in license suspension
facts.moveOverRule: Move over one lane, or slow down if you cannot safely change lanes, for stopped emergency, law-enforcement, and recovery vehicles displaying flashing lights
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: Reduced posted limit during school hours (commonly 15-25 mph where posted)

references.label: Graduated Driver License
references.citation: IIHS Graduated Licensing Laws Table (South Carolina)
